data.additional_information:
About the Role:

We are looking for a highly motivated NLP Research Intern from IITs or IIITH or IISc to join our AI team for a one-year internship program. The selected candidate will work on advanced Natural Language Processing (NLP), Large Language Models (LLMs), and Generative AI initiatives, contributing to the development of intelligent AI solutions that address real-world business challenges.
This role offers an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in research, experimentation, model development, and deployment while working alongside experienced AI engineers and data scientists.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop and improve NLP solutions for tasks such as: 
o Text classification
o Information extraction
o Named Entity Recognition (NER)
o Semantic search
o Question Answering
o Summarization
o Conversational AI

• Work with Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI technologies.
• Collect, clean, preprocess, and analyze large text datasets.
• Fine-tune transformer-based models such as BERT, RoBERTa, T5, Llama, and similar architectures.
• Design and evaluate prompt engineering and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions.
• Perform model evaluation, benchmarking, and error analysis.
• Develop NLP pipelines and automation workflows.
• Collaborate with engineering and business teams to translate requirements into AI-powered solutions.
• Document experiments, findings, and technical recommendations.
data.additional_details:
Preferred Qualifications:

• Strong programming skills in Python.
• Solid understanding of: 
o Machine Learning
o Deep Learning
o NLP fundamentals
o Data Structures and Algorithms
• Familiarity with: 
o PyTorch or TensorFlow
o Hugging Face Transformers
o NLTK
o spaCy
o Scikit-learn
• Good analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with LLMs and Generative AI applications.
• Familiarity with: 
o RAG architectures
o Vector databases (FAISS, Chroma, Pinecone, Azure AI Search)
o LangChain or similar frameworks
o Azure/AWS/GCP cloud platforms
• Prior research, publications, internships, or open-source contributions in AI/ML/NLP.
• Knowledge of MLOps and model deployment practices.

Expected Outcomes:
During the internship, the candidate will:
• Contribute to the development of production-ready NLP and Generative AI solutions.
• Build and evaluate multiple NLP models and workflows.
• Conduct research and experimentation on emerging AI technologies.
• Deliver technical documentation and presentations.
• Collaborate with stakeholders to drive AI innovation and business impact.
